name: Jumbo Bag Limited
about: Jumbo Bag Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of flexible intermediate bulk container packaging materials for industrial purposes in India and internationally. It operates in Manufacturing and Trading segments. The company offers various types of jumbo bags, such as Type A for transporting non-combustible items; Type B anti-static jumbo bags for transporting combustible items; Type C, which is fabricated by weaving conductive tapes in warp and weft directions; Type D; Un bags for packing and transporting hazardous materials by sea, road, and air; container liners for transporting free-flowing materials across different countries; liner bags; and baffle bags for low-density fine powder materials, as well as clean hygiene bags. It also trades in polymers. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
